paragraphs: From Castlebar Test Centre on Moneen Industrial Estate Road, move off and take your 1st left to continue along Moneen Industrial Estate Road.
At the end of the road turn right onto Lawn Road.
At the roundabout take the slight left onto the R309.
At the next roundabout turn right onto Moneen Road.
Take your 1st left into Springfield Court and follow it round to the sharp right.
Pull in at a safe spot and complete a U-turn.
Take the sharp left back out of Springfield Court and turn right at the end onto Moneen Road.
At the roundabout turn right onto Gorteendrunagh.
Turn right onto the R373.
Take the next right onto Richard Street.
At the end of the road turn right onto Thomas Street.
Continue straight as it becomes Staball Hill.
At the end of the road turn left onto Turlough Road.
At the end of Turlough Road turn right onto Pontoon Road.
Take your 1st left into Pontoon Drive and follow the estate roads round for a practice stop.
Move off again, complete a U-turn and retrace your way back out to Pontoon Road, turning right.
Continue straight as the road becomes Davitts Terrace and then New Antrim Street.
Turn left onto Linenhall Street.
Turn right onto Main Street and follow it straight through Ellison Street, Mountain View and Westport Road.
At the end of the road turn left onto Lannagh Road.
At the roundabout take the slight left onto Humbert Way and pull in for the arrival stop.
Move off again along Humbert Way and at the roundabout continue straight onto Lawn Road.
At the next roundabout take the slight left to stay on Lawn Road.
Take your 1st right back onto Moneen Industrial Estate Road to return to Castlebar Test Centre.
